<script>document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    let subnav = document.querySelector('.lm-subnav .uk-tab');
    let leftArrow = document.querySelector('.lm-arrow-left');
    let rightArrow = document.querySelector('.lm-arrow-right');
    let initialLoad = true;

    if(leftArrow && rightArrow) {

    leftArrow.addEventListener('click', () => {
//        subnav.scrollLeft -= 100; // Adjust
        subnav.scrollBy({
            top: 0,
            left: -150,
            behavior: 'smooth'
        }); // Adjust
      // can check also here
    }, false);
    rightArrow.addEventListener('click', () => {
//        subnav.scrollLeft += 100; // Adjust
        subnav.scrollBy({
            top: 0,
            left: +150,
            behavior: 'smooth'
        });
      // can check also here
    }, false);

    function checkArrows() {

        let maxScrollLeft = subnav.scrollWidth - subnav.clientWidth;

        if (subnav.scrollLeft === 0) {
            if (initialLoad) {
                leftArrow.classList.add('uk-hidden');
            } else {
                setTimeout(()=> {
                    leftArrow.classList.add('uk-hidden');
                }, 1000);
            }
        } else {
            leftArrow.classList.remove('uk-hidden');
        }

        if (subnav.scrollLeft >= maxScrollLeft) {
            setTimeout(()=> {
                rightArrow.classList.add('uk-hidden');
            }, 1000);
        } else {
            rightArrow.classList.remove('uk-hidden');

        }

        initialLoad = false;
    }

    // Initial check
    checkArrows();

    // Event listener for scrolling
    subnav.addEventListener('scroll', checkArrows);

    }
